Agree with Lauren — GitHub first. A few quick levers to consider (high level):

- Seat pooling across business units to reduce peak counts (requires procurement + IAM approvals).
- Multi-year commit (24–36 months) for GHE with upfront or annual billing to lower per-seat.
- JetBrains: All Products pack + education/dev grants for small teams; often easier to get a 20–30% uplift on list if we commit 2 years.
- Atlassian: consider moving to usage-based seats for Confluence to save on inactive accounts.

I attached a short vendor_terms_summary.docx with examples from prior renewals (discount triggers, invoice cadence, termination windows). My recommendation: we run parallel talks but prioritize GitHub negotiation cadence this month so procurement can start paperwork.

I can take the JetBrains thread if Alex picks GitHub.
